_note: Founding traditions: before round 1 the player picks traditions_to_pick (data/balance.json) of these (one), a random one with tradition_random_bonus goods, or none. Each tilts the run: buildings (their cards come up tradition_card_weight times as often in the building hand), leaning (that leaning is always one of the two tribesperson cards shuffled into each dawn's pool, so it is offered more often, and its bands form tradition_band_ease sooner), effects (summed with relics' in RunState.mod(), same keys as data/relics.json) start (goods added when chosen) and blueprint (Yusuf, 2026-10-26: drafted for the town as it is founded, in place of one of round 1's drafts: a building type, or craft:<id> for a craft with the market if the town has none; BuildHand.gift). sim/run_state.gd choose_traditions.

hunters.name: Hunters
hunters.text: Born to the chase. Hunting lodges, hide racks and drying racks come up often, foragers band sooner, and heroes hit 1 harder.

woodfolk.name: Woodfolk
woodfolk.text: People of the deep woods. Foresters, charcoal pits and longhouses come up often, woodcutters band sooner, and you start with 10 more wood.

stoneworkers.name: Stoneworkers
stoneworkers.text: Wall-builders. Stone-layers' yards, gates and watch posts come up often, quarriers band sooner, and towers shoot 2 harder.

firekeepers.name: Firekeepers
firekeepers.text: Keepers of the flame. Charcoal pits, spirit shrines and smoke huts come up often, brushcutters band sooner, and the fire burns 1 less fuel a night.

traders.name: Traders
traders.text: Shell-counters and hagglers. The market, its stalls and the mead hall come up often, traders leave 5 more shells every round, and the southern caravan lays out 1 more deal.

smiths.name: Smiths
smiths.text: Workers of flint and metal. Knappers, bone carvers, smelters and bronzesmiths come up often, prospectors band sooner, and heroes pay 20% less for gear.
